typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like). Panel headers ('Vector at Pos …') are bold red, slightly larger than equation text. The title banner line is bold red, the largest text on the slide. Equations are regular weight, medium size, using Unicode-style superscripts (²) for squares; heavy use of color-coding (red for ωt/a-terms, blue for ωδ/b-terms) and yellow/cyan highlighter backgrounds instead of italics/bold for emphasis. The final result '=2 (1-cos(ωδ) )' is bold red. The rotated ribbon text is bold red. Slide number is a red numeral inside a circled badge. No serif fonts, no all-caps styling beyond normal capitalization; quotes around t and t+δ are curly quotes.
